title: Fitbit Sleep Log Minutes Asleep Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fitbit:sleep minutes_asleep=*
| stats sum(minutes_asleep) as total_value, avg(minutes_asleep) as avg_value by sleep_stage
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sleep stage values by total and average minutes asleep across Fitbit sleep log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `minutes_asleep` values for each Fitbit sleep log event and review total and average minutes asleep by sleep stage.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total minutes asleep.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises which sleep stage shows the biggest minutes asleep numbers in your Fitbit sleep log data.
